newsitem.title: UK: Nigeria raises February crude prices by 3-8 cents.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria raises February crude prices by 3-8 cents.

text.p: Nigeria on Monday raised crude price formulas by three to eight cents a barrel for February loadings compared to January, traders said.
Nigerian National Petroleum Corp (NNPC) raised the price of Bonny Light and Qua Iboe for February by three cents to Dated Brent plus 53 cents.
Forcados went up eight cents to Dated Brent plus 68 cents.
Bonny Medium was raised by three cents to Dated Brent plus 53 cents.
Brass River was increased by seven cents to Dated Brent plus 45 cents.
Escravos went up six cents for February to Dated Brent plus 44 cents.
Pennington was raised by three cents to Dated Brent plus 88 cents.
NNPC raised the premium payable for deferred pricing of February liftings, 14 days after bill of lading, by five cents to 15 cents.
Traders said the new prices were in line with market expectations.
